children: CAVA announced a $100 million share repurchase program to buy outstanding common stock through Sept 17, 2027.
Board authorized up to $100 million to repurchase common stock, execution at company discretion.
Repurchases may occur in open market, privately negotiated transactions, or via Rule 10b5-1 plans.
Program expires September 17, 2027 and can be modified, suspended, or terminated anytime.
Repurchases expected to be funded with existing cash, cash equivalents and cash flows from operations.
